terminalGrammar: EXACT normalStages[0..4] + EXACTLY ONE terminal rejection; no further event. Other valid traces are nonempty prefixes of normalStages.
traceAlphabet: ASCII lowercase letters, digits, underscore and LF; names and order closed
bootstrapAdmitted: actual bootstrap status0 AND full valid normal trace AND final step success
unavailable: actual step failure; lastObserved only a Source observation, not historical cause
guardRules: Preserve original operation/guard order and failure/raise semantics; no duplicate queries; fixed terminal only at an actual failed operation/guard; arbitrary xattr error is NOT capabilities-present. No paths/UIDs/capability bytes/errno/exceptions/env or rawstderr.
